newsitem.title: USA: NY official hopes study improves LaGuardia access.
newsitem.headline: NY official hopes study improves LaGuardia access.

text.p: The chairman of the Empire State Development Corp on Wednesday said he hoped a planned engineering study on using mass transit to link Wall Street to LaGuardia Airport would produce results.
"This is not going to be a study that is just going to sit on the shelf," said Charles Gargano, speaking at a conference sponsored by Crain's New York Business.
The plan being studied involves expanding subway lines to link the financial district on Wall Street to the airport.
The state official, however, did not say there were any guarantees that such a project would go ahead, saying at present there is only a commitment to an engineering study.
